g.title: RoofMotion
g.text: one step per worker poll · west opens first, east closes first
green = a relay is energized · grey = both relays off
a half already at its target is skipped from OPEN_KICK or CLOSE_RODCLEAR, before anything is energized

g.title: OPEN_KICK
g.text: rod goes out once the relay is closed,
and is retried until the board acknowledges

g.title: OPEN_SETTLE
g.text: relays off, rod running its stroke

g.title: OPEN_SETTLE->OPEN_RUN
g.text: and the closed switches are clear

g.title: OPEN_SETTLE->FAULT
g.text: so there is no stroke to wait for;
or it did not finish within
still closed after a full stroke

g.title: ANY
g.text: · this phase's outer budget ran out, and each phase has exactly one:
roofOpenPrepBudget() up to OPEN_RUN, roof_travel_timeout for the
two run phases, roof_close_overrun for the tighten
· a Roof consistency check latched (any status read)
· the board refused a command (CMDUNKN) past writeCmd()'s retries

g.title: STOP
g.text: straight to the relays, on the caller's thread:
needs no board, no worker and no roofLock
